ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop'. Two lists render with key={r.id} (grid cell at L62 and table row at L98) but some vending rows may share/lack id. Consider using r.colonna (which IS guaranteed unique in the grid) as key.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) In Vending.jsx (L62 and L98) switch key from r.id to r.colonna (or ensure every vending doc has stable unique id) to silence React duplicate-key warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auto_order() at L810: motivo strings are inconsistent — when giac_negozio<=0 && vend_30gg>=fast_min && giac_vending==0 the code emits 'FAST MOVER: REINTEGRO' (identical string used again at L820 for a totally different situation). The two branches should have distinct motivi so operators can distinguish 'shop-empty fast-mover' from 'shop-under-threshold fast-mover'.

server.py /api/vending/ricarica-pdf (L575) does its reportlab imports inside the request handler — small latency cost per call. Move imports to module top for consistency with /api/auto-order/pdf which does the same in-handler pattern.

tableHooks.js useSortSearch: `searchFields` is included in useMemo deps but the caller usually passes a fresh array literal each render → the memo is effectively invalidated every render. Wrap searchFields in useMemo at call sites or accept a stable reference/spread the keys individually to gain real memoization.

Magazzino.jsx L61 uses key={r.codice}. If two products in DB share the same codice (as happened after prior iterations created two TEST_DB_ONLY products), React warns and rows may render incorrectly. Prefer key={r.id} (or enforce codice uniqueness at DB level with a unique index).
Repeated from iteration_7 and still open: _import_parametri no bounds check (AGGIO_PCT), _import_storico no transaction/atomic replace, per-row errors swallowed in _import_prodotti.
